# Generated by ppc finalize (line_level_counts.py); do not edit by hand.
# Location scope: the standing levels of each manufacturing line (every building type carrying the line's
# local_pp_<good>_line_levels counter), in whole levels. The specialization town rights read these: the counters
# themselves read less than the levels while an input is short (the engine scales raw_modifier by input
# fulfilment) and 0 in a line that gets no inputs.

	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:beer_workshop } add = "location_building_level(building_type:beer_workshop)" }

}
